name: Subsidy Scheme For Purchase Of Taxi / Goods Vehicle / Passenger Autorickshaw
briefDescription: This scheme provides a financial subsidy to individuals sanctioned for a bank loan to purchase a taxi, goods vehicle, or passenger autorickshaw in Karnataka.
descriptionMd: The Subsidy Scheme for Purchase of Taxi / Goods Vehicle / Passenger Autorickshaw offers financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries in Karnataka. It aims to support individuals who receive bank loans for purchasing commercial vehicles, thereby promoting self-employment and economic empowerment.
benefitsMd:
- Subsidy of 33% of the vehicle value or a maximum of Rs. 2.5 Lakhs, whichever is less.
- Financial assistance for the purchase of Passenger Autorickshaw, Goods Vehicle, or Taxi.
eligibilityMd:
- Beneficiaries must be sanctioned or approved for a loan from a Bank.
- The loan must be specifically for the purchase of a Passenger Autorickshaw, Goods Vehicle, or Taxi.
- Women beneficiaries will receive priority during the selection process.
applicationMd: Contact the nodal department or visit the official scheme portal to apply.
